headline: Last session: Sensex dropped 570 points and Nifty fell to 22,421 amid heavy foreign investor selling.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) turned net sellers, pulling out ₹35,860 crore in September.
Rising crude oil prices and global rate hike concerns sparked continuous equity outflows.
En-masse selling by foreign investors wiped out approximately ₹9 lakh crore in investor wealth.
Persistent global macroeconomic risks and geopolitical uncertainties weighed heavily on market sentiment.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today, October 3, 2026, as it is a weekend.
Markets were also closed on Friday, October 2, 2026, for the Gandhi Jayanti holiday.
In the previous trading session, Sensex crashed 570.59 points while Nifty tanked to 22,421.95.
Indian benchmark shares posted their worst monthly performance since March, extending their weekly losing run.
summary: Indian benchmark indices remain closed today, Saturday, October 3, 2026, for the weekend. In the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty extended their losing streak amid heavy foreign investor outflows and global macroeconomic headwinds. Markets will reopen for regular trading on Monday, October 5.
